properties.description:
One shared receipt shape for every write, cut at ONE place: the `call_tool` choke point (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/receipt.rs). It applies to every tool the served surface marks as a write (read_only_hint false), so a new write tool joins by being served.

THE RECEIPT, by default:
- the node's (or edge's) id and type;
- each stored value of at most 200 characters echoed as stored, and each longer one given by size under `elided`;
- a revise's replaced fields with `prior_chars` and `after_chars`, and `prior_in` naming the snapshot that keeps the prior value;
- every warning, note, drawn edge and removal report (`shortened`, `fields_at_risk`) exactly as the handler wrote it.

A prior value NOTHING else holds (`fields_at_risk`) is still echoed in full, because then the reply is its only copy. `echo: "node"` returns the reply exactly as the handler built it; an unknown `echo` is refused before the handler runs.

DESIGN CHOICES AND WHY THE OTHERS LOST (2026-09-29, R-E):
(1) Shaping at the choke point rather than a smaller reply in each handler. About 150 write handlers each built their own reply, which is how the class arose; one layer covers all of them and any future one. Handlers still build the full reply, so `echo: "node"` costs nothing, and tests that call a handler directly still read everything it wrote.
(2) Short values echoed rather than none. A writer checks status, kind, a short name or a reference, and those cost little. The measured cost was the multi-kilobyte prose fields.
(3) Size plus the snapshot's name, rather than the prior text, for a preserved prior value. The text is recoverable from the snapshot, and the prior block exists to prevent loss, not to repeat what is kept.

MEASURED on the same calls (reply as built → receipt): add_decision with a 6,000-character body 6,311 → 560; replace_text of 12 chars onto a 1-char rationale 6,961 → 1,243; replace_text of 170 chars onto a 6,000-char body 13,322 → 1,453; set_decision_status 6,397 → 473; add_component revise 6,786 → 1,067; add_requirement 6,818 → 1,064; record_finding 6,356 → 606; create_edge with 6,000-char evidence 6,165 → 414.

Planned by the 2026-09-29 fix program; built on branch feat/a-write-replies-with-a-receipt.

SHIPPED 2026-09-29 in reflow2 PR #630 (squash 5f69a7c). Its change record, chg:a-write-replies-with-a-receipt, and its passing check, ver:a-write-replies-with-a-receipt (tests/a_write_replies_with_a_receipt.rs, observed failing 3 of 3 on origin/main 72917f6 first), are in main's committed export, NOT in this live store.

The status here stays `planned` on purpose: setting it to realized with no passing check in THIS store would be an unproven claim. The live store will reflect the delivery when main's records are folded in (ver:an-overlay-folds-after-a-squash-merge). The live server also still runs 0.74.0.
properties.name: Write tools reply with a receipt (id, fields changed with sizes, edges drawn as sentences, every warning and removal report), not the whole stored node
